chunks: If only we had a return, then we would be among the believers!
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'If only we could return' in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:102) underscores the concept of 'finality of the breath' (Nafas al-Mawt), illustrating that the opportunity for repentance ceases once death occurs. It serves as a poignant reminder of the regret felt by those who delayed faith until the moment of death, emphasizing the urgency of seizing the present moment for spiritual growth.
